purpose: Teach: ６つ/ミソ/外野/ヤミ/タネ/キズ/オジサン/くず

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ケーキを６つご注文だったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, a customer ordered six cakes today.
lines.style: Soft, observational tone. Speaking as though recounting a detail worth remembering. Warm toward Aoi. Slight upward lilt, like sharing something noticed.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お味噌、つまりミソ味のスイーツがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer really does love miso-flavored sweets, doesn't he.
lines.style: Gentle realization in the voice. Quiet certainty — not a question, more a small moment of understanding. Thoughtful pace, as if noticing a pattern.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「外野の意見は気にしない」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he said he doesn't let other people's opinions bother him.
lines.style: Slight admiration underneath. Repeating his words like they matter. Careful, respectful tone — not gossiping, but witnessing something real about him.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ヤミ金融の被害について語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he talked about something difficult — being harmed by predatory lending.
lines.style: More serious now. Respectfully lowered volume, as if honoring what he shared. Slow, careful delivery. The weight of him trusting them with something hard.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お手製ジャムのタネ、つまりレシピを教えて下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he shared his homemade jam recipe with us.
lines.style: Warm surprise. A small lift of genuine delight — the gift of being trusted with something personal and creative. Generous tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、新作のキズ、つまり傷物の割引品を喜んでらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he was happy about the discounted items with minor flaws.
lines.style: Quiet amusement, observant. As if noticing something kindly human in him — that he didn't need perfection. Gentle, knowing tone.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、自分を「ただのオジサンですから」って笑ってらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he called himself just an ordinary man and laughed about it.
lines.style: Dry affection underneath. A slight smile in the voice — catching the self-deprecation and the humility in it. Wry but warm, not mocking.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「くず鉄」を集めるご趣味のお話をして下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, he told us about his hobby collecting scrap metal.
lines.style: Reflective, gentle. The voice of someone noticing and honoring a quiet, particular passion. Unhurried. A soft fade at the end.
